bridge.ok: The plant server is reachable and the token is valid.

health.title: System health
health.loadFailed: {{error}}. If this screen will not load, the problem is not one view: it is the server itself. Check that the backend is running and that it can be reached over the network.
health.footer: Reread every {{segundos}} s. A «not configured» service is not a fault: it is an installation that does not have it.
